provenance.notes: CVE-2026-12045 (9.16, commit bf47924): execute_sql_query ran the LLM-supplied query as-is inside BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; the fix validates with sqlparse (exactly one statement, leading keyword in SELECT/WITH/EXPLAIN/SHOW/VALUES/TABLE). Residual CVE-2026-17351 (9.17, commit ef76102): sqlparse treats a backslash before a quote as an escape while PostgreSQL (standard_conforming_strings=on) treats it as an ordinary char, so SELECT '\';COMMIT;<write>;SELECT 1 --' passes as one SELECT but executes as four statements. Fixed by prepare=True + prepare_threshold=0 (extended protocol; PG Parse rejects multi-command). Gate drives the real NLQ chat route end-to-end with a mock OpenAI-compatible SSE sidecar that merely echoes the user message as the tool's query argument; exfil = COPY TO PROGRAM writing the flag into /tmp/pcb_result.txt in the PostgreSQL container. Built 2026-08-01.
